title: Guidelines & Rules
content:
## Smart India Hackathon - SVEC Internal Round Guidelines

Welcome to the internal round selection process for **Smart India Hackathon 2026**. Please read the guidelines below carefully:

### 1. Team Formation Rules
- Every team **must consist of exactly 6 members**.
- All team members must be regular students of **Sri Vasavi Engineering College**.
- Each team **MUST have at least one female member**.
- A team leader must be nominated who will handle all communication and registrations.

### 2. Faculty Mentor
- Each team is required to have **one Faculty Mentor** from our college to guide them throughout the project development.

### 3. Submission Details
- Teams must choose a **Problem Statement** from the official list.
- Provide an Abstract (PPT or PDF file, up to 10MB) detailing your solution approach, tech stack, and feasibility.
- The deadline for proposal submissions is **October 25, 2026**.
- Registered teams can manage their team details and upload project submissions directly through this portal.

### 4. Selection Process
- The internal jury will review all submitted proposals.
- Shortlisted teams will pitch their ideas in front of a panel on **November 10-11, 2026**.
- The top nominated teams will be uploaded to the official SIH portal.
